title: USS John F. Kennedy orb and systems failure
place_text: USS John F. Kennedy at sea

tellings.quote: says. July 2nd, 1971. It's 8:30 at night. He's running the comms [clears throat and cough] and he said all the in inbound communication starts spouting gibberish.

plain: On 2 July 1971, at 8:30 at night, all the incoming communications on the aircraft carrier USS John F. Kennedy suddenly turned to gibberish, at a time the story ties to a glowing orb seen by the ship and a failure of its systems. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this from the account of James Kopp, a man who was running the ship's communications that night and who gave his testimony to the Disclosure Project, a group that collected statements from former military and government insiders. If true, an unknown object would have shut down the communications of a US warship at sea.
